genel.label: General
genel.help: The design language's name and a style note for what settings cannot express.

fontlar.label: Fonts
fontlar.help: Which fonts are used, on which lines and within which limits.

ozel-karakterler.label: Special characters
ozel-karakterler.help: Rules for printing certain characters in another font or size.

boyut.label: Size and fill
boyut.help: How large the text is and how the lines relate to each other.

bosluk.label: Line spacing and alignment
bosluk.help: The visible gap between lines and how they are aligned.

baglaclar.label: Connectors
baglaclar.help: How connectors like &, and, e, y are set.

satir-bolme.label: Line breaking
satir-bolme.help: How the text is split into lines.

cikti.label: Label sizes
cikti.help: Cut shape, label sizes and the template position.

sticker.label: Stickers
sticker.help: How sticker orders are detected, and their sheets.

baski.label: Printing
baski.help: Extra-label and resolution rules for print sheets.

kalite.label: Quality flags
kalite.help: Check and legibility flags for variations.

name.label: Name
name.help: The name of the design language.

description.label: Description
description.help: A short description: whose it is and which jobs it is for.

instructions.label: Style note
instructions.help: Style that settings cannot express (e.g. 'elegant, airy, romantic'). Hard rules go to the matching setting, not here.

list.label: Font list
list.help: The available fonts, their kinds, roles and limits.

mixing.label: Font families per label
mixing.help: One family: every line uses the same font (except special-character rules). Two families or free.

glyphRules.label: Special character rules
glyphRules.help: E.g. '&' always in IM FELL at half size; a capital A at the start of a word from another font. Applies on every line.

fill.label: Fill
fill.help: Text is this fraction of the largest size that fits the area. 1 = completely full.

fillLocked.label: Fill is fixed
fillLocked.help: When on, every design uses the same fill; when off, the AI may suggest one.

primary.label: Main line
primary.help: The largest line (usually the name). The other ratios are relative to it.

secondary.label: Secondary line
secondary.help: Supporting lines smaller than the main line.

tertiary.label: Tertiary line
tertiary.help: The smallest lines (date, place, long message).

connector.label: Lone connector
connector.help: Ratio of a connector on its own line to the main line.

tiersLocked.label: Engine applies the ratios
tiersLocked.help: When on, the AI only picks a line's class and these ratios set the size.

connectorScales.label: Connector-specific ratio
connectorScales.help: A different ratio for a specific connector (e.g. 'e' 0.45).

maxCapHeight.label: Letter height limit
maxCapHeight.help: Keeps short texts from growing too large: capital height is at most this fraction of the cut diameter.

breathing.label: Breathing room
breathing.help: Space left between the text and the decoration (as a fraction of the cut diameter).

edgeMargin.label: Cut margin
edgeMargin.help: Space left between the text and the cut line (as a fraction of the cut diameter).

oneLine.label: Initials on one line
oneLine.help: Text that is only initials ('A & M') is never stacked.

maxCapHeight.label: Initials height
maxCapHeight.help: Letter height limit for labels that are only initials. Empty = general limit.

align.label: Alignment
align.help: Lines are centered on the ink box (or aligned left or right).

normal.label: Line gap
normal.help: Visible gap between lines, as a fraction of the small line's point size.

beforeLast.label: Before the last small line
beforeLast.help: Gap before the last small line such as a date or place.

connector.label: Around a connector
connector.help: Gap above and below a connector on its own line.

beforeLastRatio.label: Last line threshold
beforeLastRatio.help: A last line smaller than this fraction of the one above counts as the 'last small line'.

words.label: Connectors
words.help: Words and symbols that count as connectors (&, and, e, y…).

shiftEm.label: Connector shift to the right
shiftEm.help: A lone connector between two script names moves this far right of the names' center (in name point size).

separateDangling.label: No dangling connectors
separateDangling.help: A connector left at the start or end of a line ('Elena' / 'e Martina') goes on its own line.

allowSymbolSpacing.label: Space around &
allowSymbolSpacing.help: In 'Mina&Ali' breathing space may be added around the & (the text does not count as changed).

maxLineChars.label: Line length limit
maxLineChars.help: No line exceeds this many characters.

typicalLines.label: Typical line count
typicalLines.help: The line range of most labels (fewest – most).

maxLines.label: Most lines
maxLines.help: No label has more lines than this.

nameOwnLine.label: Name on its own line
nameOwnLine.help: The person's name is on its own line and is the largest line.

coupleStack.label: Couples stacked
coupleStack.help: For couple names, the name / & / name layout: always, one of the candidates, or never.

keepShortGreetings.label: Keep short greetings together
keepShortGreetings.help: When on, greetings and thanks of up to three words ('Thank You', 'Merry Christmas') are never split; the engine and the AI check this. If you do split some greetings (e.g. a holiday greeting over two lines), turn it off and write the distinction in the line-breaking notes and examples.

dateOwnLine.label: Date on its own line
dateOwnLine.help: The date stays on a separate line.

customerBreaks.label: Customer's line breaks
customerBreaks.help: If the customer gave lines with a double space: treat as a hint, apply strictly or ignore.

noLoneWords.label: Words that cannot stand alone
noLoneWords.help: Prepositions and articles (di, de, of, la…) stay with the phrase they belong to.

notes.label: Line-breaking notes
notes.help: Breaking habits that rules cannot express (the AI reads them).

examples.label: Example breaks
examples.help: Text → lines examples. Shown to the AI; stronger than a rule.

mode.label: Thickening
mode.help: Stroke: a thin outline in the text's own color (when the font has no Bold). Real: the font's bold style.

widthEm.label: Stroke thickness
widthEm.help: Fraction of the main line's point size. One value per label.

minPx.label: Thinnest stroke
minPx.help: The stroke is at least this many px. 0 = no limit.

maxPx.label: Thickest stroke
maxPx.help: The stroke is at most this many px. 0 = no limit.

align.label: Stroke alignment
align.help: Outside: the spaces inside letters do not close.

onDark.label: Text color on dark
onDark.help: The color used when the background is dark.

autoContrast.label: Automatic contrast
autoContrast.help: Switch to a light color on its own when the background is dark.

designFramePx.label: Design area
designFramePx.help: The square area (px) where all calculations are made.

cut.label: Cut shape
cut.help: The label's cut line (circle, oval, rectangle…).

templateBox.label: Template position
templateBox.help: The position and size of the template image within the design area.

sizes.label: Label sizes
sizes.help: Size name in the JSON → cm and frame size (px). The design is made at the default size; at other sizes the template and text scale proportionally (content scale, otherwise frame / design area).

defaultSize.label: Default size
defaultSize.help: Used when the order does not state a size.

enabled.label: Sticker orders
enabled.help: When on, some orders are prepared as stickers instead of labels.

detect.label: How stickers are detected
detect.help: Orders that have a product field, or orders with an empty template.

sheets.label: Sticker sheets
sheets.help: Sticker sheets: product keywords and sizes. Sizes are in pt (1 pt = 1/72 inch ≈ 0.35 mm; 108 pt = 38.1 mm).

labelExtraMin.label: Extra labels (fewest)
labelExtraMin.help: The fewest extra labels printed above the order quantity.

labelExtraMax.label: Extra labels (most)
labelExtraMax.help: The most extra labels printed on large orders.

labelRoundUpMaxExtra.label: Complete the sheet
labelRoundUpMaxExtra.help: If the remaining labels are at most this many short of a full sheet, the sheet is completed with the same order.

labelExtraScaleLow.label: Extra scale (low quantity)
labelExtraScaleLow.help: At this quantity and below, the fewest extras are printed.

labelExtraScaleHigh.label: Extra scale (high quantity)
labelExtraScaleHigh.help: At this quantity and above, the most extras are printed; in between it is proportional.

separateSameDesign.label: Separate the same design
separateSameDesign.help: Orders with the same design number are not put on the same mixed sheet (so they do not get mixed up).

stickerExtraMin.label: Sticker extras (fewest)
stickerExtraMin.help: The fewest extras above the quantity on sticker orders.

stickerExtraMax.label: Sticker extras (most)
stickerExtraMax.help: The most extras above the quantity on sticker orders.

stickerDpi.label: Sticker resolution
stickerDpi.help: PNG and raster PDF resolution (dpi) of sticker sheets. The sticker's size does not change (mm); 300 is enough for printers.

dpi.label: Print resolution
dpi.help: Resolution (dpi) of PNG output and raster PDF. 300 is enough for printers.

orderNamePattern.label: Order name pattern
orderNamePattern.help: The order name on the print sheet (cell label). {orderNo}, {quantity}, {template}, {size}, {seq} and the field names in the order file can be used; if empty, no order name is printed.

suspectScore.label: Check threshold
suspectScore.help: A variation scoring below this is flagged 'check'.

readableMinPt.label: Legibility limit
readableMinPt.help: A warning is given if the smallest line is below this.
